parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain names to accelerate with DCDN. You can specify up to 20 domain names, separated by commas.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. If you omit this parameter, the system uses the default resource group.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description:
The acceleration region. Valid values:

- `domestic` (Default): Chinese mainland only.

- `overseas`: Global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

- `global`: Global.

parameters.name: Sources
parameters.description: A JSON string specifying the origin servers.
